rationale: Adds a closed native review catalogue, accepted fixed-check recipes, complete checked context and post-seal idempotent publication, preserving executable oracles while removing generic model shell and external publishing. Canonical JSON call binding retains every value/type, and legacy diagnostics keep their original meaning. Denied/missing/mismatch/material/false-claim rules remain fatal; partial publication cannot bypass completion through reuse or a new model call. Only CI tooling and documentation change, with historical reviews preserved.

summary.ru: Инструменты ревью отказывают в подмене реализации и проверяют execution trace до публикации отчёта.
summary.en: Review tools refuse implementation replacement and verify the execution trace before publishing a report.
